title: Normalized slice evaluation on K-flat and K-injective representatives
statement: Fix a small ringed site (J,A), a slice U, independent coefficient and derived-category universes, and closed structures S,S_U with the canonical tensor and uncurrying models [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Let d be slice comparison data [def-sfb-ringed-slice-comparison-model] satisfying its tensor and Hom normalization predicates. Let P be a K-flat complex whose terms are flat sheaves, and I a K-injective complex. For L=Q(P) and M=Q(I), the tensor-Hom counits obey rho(H(L,M),L)^(-1) followed by r(ev(L,M)) = (eta(L,M) tensor identity) followed by ev_U(rL,rM). This is only the representative counit computation: it neither constructs comparison data nor asserts compatibility for arbitrary objects, arbitrary transposes, or symmetries.

source.place: Tags 08J9 (lemma-internal-hom), 08JB (lemma-restriction-RHom-to-U), and the evaluation calculation in lemma-compose.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat resolution q:Q→Hom(P,I). Convert termwise categorical flatness to IsFlatOnSite using siteSheafTensorRightIso. Apply the supplied tensor normalization to Q,P and Hom normalization to P,I, obtaining gamma_t, gamma_h, kappa and kappa_U and their localization squares.

Use the ordinary signed tensor-Hom chain equivalence from the native adjunction construction to uncurry q and its restriction followed by gamma_h. Precompose with gamma_t inverse. Its pure-tensor normalization reduces both maps to evaluating the same Hom-product coordinate. Apply the local-family normalization of gamma_h at W equal to the identity of V. The sheafification adjunction and total-coproduct extensionality identify the two chain maps. This step is underived and does not use an augmentation or K-injectivity.

Apply coefficientTensorCurry_normalize on both sites. In each normalization the kappa augmentation equation rewrites Q(Hom(P,augmentation(I))) followed by the inverse fixed Hom comparison to kappa inverse. The adjunction counit formula then identifies Q(uncurry(q)) with T.iso followed by tensor(Q(q) followed by kappa inverse, identity) and evaluation. The slice version uses restricted K-flatness from d.kflat.

Naturality of the localization comparison transfers the equality of ordinary chain maps to the derived categories. Substitute the tensor normalization square. Invert kappa in the Hom normalization square, postcompose by kappa_U inverse, and precompose with r(Q(q)); naturality of localization gives the square for Q(q) followed by kappa inverse. Naturality of the evaluation counit and evaluation_naturality identify the isomorphic slice endpoints. Tensor comparison naturality completes the resulting diagram. Cancel only the tensor comparison, tensor(Q(q) followed by kappa inverse,identity), and localization isomorphisms, yielding the stated counit equation.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08J9 and 08JB, and lemma-compose (0A90); T4 uses the existing arbitrary-target currying normalization and ordinary chain-level equivalence to shorten the representative calculation.

theorem ringedSlice_representativeEvaluation
    (U : C) [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{max c v u} ((sheafCompose (J.over U) (forget₂
      CommRingCat.{max c v u} RingCat.{max c v u})).obj (A.over U)))]
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A))
    (T : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, c, v, w} J A S)
    (SU : CoefficientClosedStructure
      (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U)))
    (TU : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, max c v, v, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U) SU)
    (d : RingedSliceEvaluationComparisons (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A)
      (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U))
      (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U) S SU (RingedSliceFlatRestriction.{c, v,
      u} J A U))
      (ht : RingedSliceTensorModel.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U S T SU TU d)
      (hh : RingedSliceHomModel.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U S T SU TU d)
    (P I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂
      CommRingCat.{max c v u} RingCat.{max c v u})).obj A)) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := A) P)
    (fP : ∀ n, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := J) (R := A) (P.X n))
    [I.IsKInjective] :
    (d.rho ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A).obj (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P),
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).inv ≫
        (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).map
            (S.evaluation (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) =
      SU.tensor.map (X := ((ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj
        ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A).obj (op (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P),
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))),
        (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))) (Y :=
        ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U)).obj (op
        ((ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)),
        (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)),
        (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)))
      ((d.eta (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)).hom, 𝟙 _) ≫
        SU.evaluation
          ((ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
          ((ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))
